title: Community Internship
description:
Responsibilities

Support the day-to-day operations of the Community team to ensure smooth execution of community initiatives.

Manage community engagement across various communication channels and social media platforms.

Assist in preparing community reports and monitoring campaign performance.

Collaborate with internal teams to support community campaigns and initiatives.

Support the preparation of community photoshoots and video shoots.

Communicate with brand partners to explore collaboration opportunities for campaigns and giveaways.

Support the KOL team by researching and compiling potential affiliates for campaign activations.

Assist with administrative and operational tasks related to Community activities.

Requirements

Final-year undergraduate student or fresh graduate in Marketing, Communication, Business, Public Relations, or a related field.

Available for a full-time internship (minimum 3 months) and willing to work from the Little Joy Head Office, J, West Jakarta.

Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the confidence to engage with communities, creators, and external partners.

Active on social media platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, and Threads, with a good understanding of digital trends and online communities.

Organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and capable of managing multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

Comfortable working collaboratively with cross-functional teams and supporting day-to-day operational activities.

Familiar with Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace, especially Excel/Google Sheets.

Passionate about community building, social media, and brand engagement.

Previous internship or organizational experience in community management, social media, KOL/influencer management, partnerships, or event execution is a plus.

Willing to learn, take initiative, and grow in a dynamic startup environment.
